exercises.question: A tangent line touches a circle of radius 5 cm. Find the distance from the center of the circle to a point on the tangent line 12 cm away from the point of tangency.
exercises.question_amharic: አንድ ታንጀንት መስመር ራዲየሱ 5 ሳ.ሜ የሆነን ክበብ ይነካል። ከክበቡ መገናኛ ነጥብ 12 ሳ.ሜ ርቀት ላይ በሚገኝ ታንጀንት ላይ ላለ ነጥብ ከማዕከሉ ያለውን ርቀት ፈልጉ።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. Radius r = 5 cm is perpendicular to tangent segment x = 12 cm.\n2. Apply d² = 5² + 12² = 25 + 144 = 169.\n3. d = √169 = 13 cm.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. Radius r = 5 cm is perpendicular to tangent segment x = 12 cm.\n2. Apply d² = 5² + 12² = 25 + 144 = 169.\n3. d = √169 = 13 cm.
